summary: The preparer notes that during preparation of the Final Statement, the Board of Education District No. 170 reviewed the Roosevelt School property status, and that the U.S. Department of Interior - Bureau of Outdoor Recreation was subsequently asked to opine that the Roosevelt School no longer constituted a Section 4(f) involvement, with the November 7, 1974 letter directing that determination to the Director of the Park District for Chicago Heights.
text: During the preparation of the Final Statement a review of the status of the Roosevelt School property involvement was conducted by the Board of Education, District No. 170 (See page G-7). Based upon this determination the U.S. Department of Interior - Bureau of Outdoor Recreation was requested to give opinion that the use of the Roosevelt School no longer constituted a Section 4(f) involvement. In a letter dated November 7, 1974, the United States Department of the Interior stated that the proper person to make a determination of recreation significance would be the Directr of the Park District for Chicago Heights. (See page G-5 and Chapter III, page III-7 for the present status)
